children: Fiji's annual inflation accelerated to 7.6% in August 2026 from 5.7% in July, the highest inflation rate since December 2011, as food inflation accelerated to 9.5%, the highest since April 2024.

Inflation also accelerated for housing (7.0% vs 6.1% in July) and miscellaneous goods and services (3.6% vs 2.7%), while rebounding for clothing and footwear (1.2% vs -0.3%) and furnishings, household equipment, and routine household maintenance (0.6% vs -0.6%).
Meanwhile, inflation moderated for alcoholic beverages and tobacco (13.3% vs 14.3%), while remaining steady for transport prices (at 11.7%) and education (at 0.4%).
Additionally, recreation and culture prices fell at a much softer pace (-0.7% vs -2.4%).
On a monthly basis, the CPI edged down 0.1% in August, following a 1.1% drop in July, marking the second straight monthly decline.

title: Fiji Inflation Hits Highest Since 2011
